I'm finishing the square root calculation—the denominator comes out to about 21,319,660. Now I can divide the numerator by this to get the correlation coefficient, which gives me roughly 0.80. arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for member countries (excluding EC6 aggregate)
areas = [30528, 674843, 248717, 301336, 2586, 41526]
gdps  = [58.316, 312.966, 400.554, 265.192, 2.938, 83.351]

n = len(areas)
mean_area = sum(areas) / n
mean_gdp  = sum(gdps) / n

cov = sum((areas[i] - mean_area) * (gdps[i] - mean_gdp) for i in range(n))
sd_area = math.sqrt(sum((a - mean_area)**2 for a in areas))
sd_gdp  = math.sqrt(sum((g - mean_gdp)**2 for g in gdps))

r = cov / (sd_area * sd_gdp)
print(f"Mean area: {mean_area}")
print(f"Mean gdp:  {mean_gdp}")
print(f"r = {r:.4f}")
print(f"r = {round(r, 2)}")
EOF
